Supper tonite - Afghan Curry Chicken
Feedback
1. Not spicy at all. Very mild... Even a 8 year old can eat it.
2. Think got the chicken rib part - would have preferred breast or wing
3. Chicken is quite tasty. Very happy - 3 meals in the row got the taste right
4. Rice is ok, would be happier with 25% more rice
5. Veges are fresh. Left it in freezer then re-heated in microwave

Chicken Meatballs Eaten on day 2
The vegetables were cooked nicely al dente. Feekah was tender but not mushy.
The sauce was spiced just right and was very flavourful.
The meatballs were tender and tasty. However I found them to have a slightly odd texture that was a little slimy. I asked others to try and they agreed on the texture issue.
Porion size was good.
Easy to heat up.
Overall a good dish.

Afghan Chicken - Eaten on day 3
Again vegetables were done al dente and they had a little char that I like.
Brown rice was tender.
The sauce on the chicken was very greasy and under spiced for my palate.
Chicken was tender.
Portion size was good.
Easy to heat up.
Overall would not recommend this dish.

Chicken Mandi. 

Portion size is good. Flavors good.  

But again too oily.  Way too oily.

We loved the lamb the best because the lamb remained moist and the rice was full of flavour.

Likewise too, the chicken mandi. The chicken was a bit dry. In fact that’s true of all the chicken. They were all on the dry side.

The brown rice was hard and it was hard for it to compete against the basmati rice because of that. However if we had eaten it separately on different days, then the comparison might not have been as apparent.

Generally all the dishes were well seasoned and we liked the flavours. 

The hiccup was the lid of the box. It comes off too easily and the food fell out when I was opening it. Fortunately it was the lotus leaf so the rice was intact inside the leaf
